item.tib: dam can pho nya dgos bskul
item.coloph: ces phud dang gtor mas bskang zhing / srung bzlog (zlog) gi las bcol/ gsang sngags phyi nang gsang gsum spyi rgyug chab dkar nag po sngags kyi bka' srung / dam can dgos bskul zhes bya ba/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha'i mkhas) phyi rabs gshen po'i don du mdzad nas/ rje blon stang gsum/ ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi la gtad do/ bstan pa'i bka' srung u ya/ byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la u tra sig/ dus kyi bka' gter gnyis su byung nas/ stang dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa'o//
